summary: Wesson Coulomb logarithm estimate for the declared collision pair.

identity.definition: 31.0-0.5*ln(n_e)+ln(1000*T_e); keV is converted to eV by the factor 1000. Evaluation uses ln(1000)+ln(T), avoiding intermediate overflow/underflow.
identity.model: retained TORAX relation with explicit SciRel numeric boundary checks
identity.boundary: strictly positive finite T_e in keV and n_e in m^-3
assumptions: This is a mathematical weak-coupling estimate.
The caller decides whether a positive/adequate Coulomb logarithm is physically applicable.

inputs.name: T_e
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

inputs.name: n_e
inputs.dtype: real integer/float numeric scalar or array-like; converted to float64
inputs.constraints: finite and strictly positive; nonempty, boolean/string/complex/masked values rejected

outputs.name: result
outputs.constraints: Finite signed mathematical formula value; physical suitability for a collision model is caller-owned.

preconditions: strictly positive finite T_e in keV and n_e in m^-3
supported: Finite NumPy evaluation of the declared relation and broadcast shape.
excluded: Whole TORAX evolution, experimental calibration, and implicit coordinate reconstruction.
Interpreting zero or negative computed logarithms as valid weakly coupled collision physics; physical calibration or a regime-switching model.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for boolean/string/complex/masked or empty input, non-finite values, malformed or incompatible shape, and the nonpositive or singular domains named by the callable contract.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises FloatingPointError if accepted finite inputs produce an unrepresentable output; no fallback is returned.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; this is a direct algebraic mapping.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No output is returned after an exception.

provenance.lineage_summary: Self-contained SciRel implementation of lnΛ=31.0-0.5 ln(n_e)+ln(1000*T_e). Licence and attribution obligations retained from the original sources are listed under licenses/; redistribution and scientific endorsement remain human decisions.
provenance.license_status: TORAX-derived implementation: Apache-2.0; license text and attribution are included in the selected distribution.

example.description: Run the relation on a finite declared-domain case.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.physics import calculate_log_lambda_ee
r=calculate_log_lambda_ee(2., 1e19)
assert np.isfinite(r)

scope: Independent 60-digit Decimal logarithms over temperature/density/charge scales including smallest subnormal and largest float64; transformation/scaling identities.
Declared failure cases for empty, boolean/string/complex/masked, nonfinite and incompatible inputs.
Source relation attribution and comparison with actual canonical SciRel callers/dependencies.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Maintained tests establish the named relation, shape and selected boundary behavior only; they do not establish global physical calibration.
known_limitations: No external calibration or collision-frequency composition is claimed.
Only the Wesson algebra and declared numerical boundaries are covered.
